Specification: This specification models a buffered random-access file implementation together with an abstract RandomAccessFile refinement target and shared array/file utilities. The main module specifies the buffered object's internal fields, the effects of seek, read, write, flush, and setLength, and a collection of internal invariants about how the in-memory buffer relates to the logical and on-disk file contents. It verifies both safety-style invariants and refinement properties: the whole behavior refines an abstract RandomAccessFile spec, and each concrete operation refines its abstract counterpart. The model is single-threaded and does not use an explicit fault model; instead, underspecified file contents are represented using an ArbitrarySymbol value to keep the model checkable. The file also includes a TLC configuration section selecting constants, symmetry, aliasing, invariants, and properties for model checking.

IF i >= 0 /\ i < ArrayLen(file_content) THEN ArrayGet(file_content, i) ELSE ArbitrarySymbol

IF len > 0 THEN LET diskPosA == lo IN /\ file_content' = WriteToFile(file_content, diskPosA, ArraySlice(buff, 0, len)) /\ file_pointer' = diskPosA + len /\ diskPos' = lo + len ELSE UNCHANGED <<diskPos, file_pointer, file_content>>
IF fileOffset < ArrayLen(file_content) THEN ArrayGet(file_content, fileOffset) ELSE ArbitrarySymbol
IF pos < lo \/ pos >= (lo + BuffSz) THEN /\ ~dirty /\ lo' = (pos \div BuffSz) * BuffSz /\ FillBuffer ELSE UNCHANGED <<lo, diskPos, file_pointer, buff>>
IF ArrayLen(file_content) > newLength /\ file_pointer > newLength THEN file_pointer' = newLength ELSE file_pointer' \in Offset
IF curr > newLength THEN curr' = newLength ELSE UNCHANGED curr
IF lo + i < newLength THEN ArrayGet(buff, i) ELSE ArbitrarySymbol
